title: What Happens to Your Body in the Mariana Trench?
description: At 11,000 meters below the ocean, the pressure is unimaginable. Here is the exact millisecond-by-millisecond science of what extreme deep-sea crushing force does to human anatomy. Would you ever dare ride a titanium submarine to the Challenger Deep? Comment below! #Shorts #MarianaTrench #ScienceFacts #HumanLimits #DeepSea
